name: hr-tax-overview
description: Tax overview for Croatia for tax year 2026: the starting point before any Croatian tax question. Covers the tax year, the euro, the Tax Administration (Porezna uprava), residence and worldwide income, personal income tax with two local rates inside legal ranges (default 20% and 30%, band EUR 60,000 a year) and the EUR 600 monthly allowance, 12% tax on dividends and interest, profit tax at 10% or 18% split at EUR 1,000,000 of revenue, VAT at 25%, 13% and 5% with the EUR 60,000 registration limit, social contribution rates, and the main 2026 filing dates (DOH, PD, PO-SD, FINA statements). Trigger on: Croatia tax overview, Croatian tax system, porezni sustav Hrvatska, taxes in Croatia, how is Croatia taxed. Out of scope, see the domain skills: croatia-income-tax, hr-corporate-income-tax, croatia-vat-return, croatia-social-contributions, croatia-payroll, hr-cross-border, hr-transfer-pricing, croatia-tax-optimization.
